scope: One isolated preparation attempt using exactly PREPARATION-PLAN.controller_argv and its three declared child commands; stop at prepared static identity evidence or first concrete blocker.

checks.detail: Exact candidate003 plan/script hashes match Director freeze; script parsed as source only.
Confirmed early receipt retains original saved archive identity and successful byte readback; preceding inconsistent receipt retained.
Input inventory digest is checked by candidate before trusting declared preparation input identities.
Independent current read of all 463 declared input rows matches every supplied SHA-256, byte count and mode.
Seven names, versions and wheel hashes remain the unchanged native-reader lock.
Direct selected Python remains the exact canonical P11 hash/size/mode. Empty venv uses symlinks, without pip or system site packages.
Exact pip runner redirects pip imports to bound source; DEBUNDLED=False. PIP_CONFIG_FILE=/dev/null bypasses all config-file loading in inspected source.
All controller/child argv use -B and fresh explicit -X pycache_prefix. Controller validates its cache policy; prefix is absent before attempt and checked after commands/finalization.
Download uses explicit public index, wheel-only, exact hashes, no dependencies, no cache, no input, bounded timeout and zero network retries.
Install uses reviewed local wheelhouse only, no index, no dependencies, no compile and empty venv site before launch; no later venv interpreter launch.
Wheel audit rejects traversal, duplicate members, symlinks, startup hooks and incorrect package/hash inventory before installing.
Postinstall reader uses stdlib raw metadata/RECORD/file bytes; verifies all seven versions and all RECORD hashes, includes bin scripts, rejects unrecorded site files and marks native files as data.
All 12 declared fresh destination/output paths are currently absent; external task-owned destinations preserve shared inputs; captured logs use exclusive create.
One attempt only, stops on first failed operation or mismatch, retains result and post-checks; no product/Node/ldd/direct-loader/full-routine invocation appears in commands.
Source revision identifies base product bytes; Director discloses uncommitted documentary records. This is preparation, not clean-source H0 admission.

runtime_evidence_limit: Review is static. No installer, product, package import, target invocation or recovered script was executed by reviewer. The 463 observations are file identity checks, not product tests.
approval_limits: Preparation evidence does not establish H0/H1, ordinary-provider metadata agreement, full loader closure, host qualification, original-seven/full routine, R03, integration or parent closure.
Existing installer and interpreter remain supplied-host tools; no vendor-authentication or whole-host security claim.
Child command list records the controller direct preparation launches. It is not exhaustive process tracing inside package-manager internals.
If the operation fails or its outcome becomes unknown, preserve partial state and stop; this acceptance authorizes no retry or in-place repair.
